content.shortDescription: High-strength antiparasitic tablets that paralyze and eliminate internal and external parasites; fast relief from itching, rash and discomfort.
keyBenefits: Eliminates a wide range of parasites including mites, lice and intestinal worms
Fast relief from itching, irritation and inflammation
Convenient oral dosing; few doses typically required
keyFeatures: High-potency 12mg dose for moderate to severe infestations under supervision
Well-tolerated with decades of clinical use
content.longDescription: Ivermectin 12mg Tablets are a widely recognized antiparasitic used for scabies, strongyloidiasis, onchocerciasis and certain lice and worm infections. The drug paralyzes and kills parasites, helping the body clear them and easing symptoms such as itching, rash and inflammation. The 12mg strength is intended for adults who need higher-dose therapy as directed by a clinician.

content.shortDescription: Broad-spectrum anti-parasitic tablets for internal and external infestations with convenient single-dose or short-course therapy.
keyBenefits: Treats scabies, strongyloidiasis, onchocerciasis and certain lice
Rapid action with effects that persist for days
Globally trusted and used in public health programs
keyFeatures: Balanced 6mg strength suited to moderate infections
Oral tablet; can be taken with or without food
Low rate of side effects when used as directed
content.longDescription: Ivermectin 6mg Tablets immobilize and kill susceptible parasites so the body can eliminate them. Common indications include intestinal roundworms and mite-related skin disease. The product is known for convenience, quick symptom improvement and strong safety when taken under medical guidance.

content.shortDescription: Low-dose antiparasitic tablets for scabies, roundworms and lice with proven global track record.
keyBenefits: Kills mites, lice and intestinal worms
Quick relief of itching and irritation
keyFeatures: Each tablet contains 3mg ivermectin for precise dosing
content.longDescription: Ivermectin 3mg Tablets provide flexible dosing for a range of parasitic infections such as strongyloidiasis, scabies and other roundworm diseases. They are easy to take, act quickly and have been extensively studied for safety and efficacy.

content.shortDescription: Once-daily macrolide antibiotic for rapid control of respiratory, skin, ENT, UTI and certain STD infections.
keyBenefits: Targets and suppresses a broad range of bacteria
Convenient once-daily dosing with short courses
keyFeatures: Lower GI disruption versus many alternatives
content.longDescription: Azithromycin 500mg inhibits bacterial protein synthesis to stop growth at the source. It is commonly used for sinusitis, bronchitis, pneumonia, skin infections, otitis media, uncomplicated UTIs and chlamydial infection. The long half-life supports short regimens with strong compliance.

content.shortDescription: Widely prescribed macrolide antibiotic for throat, chest, ear and skin infections with 3–5 day courses.
keyBenefits: Fast, targeted control of common bacterial infections
keyFeatures: Broad-spectrum activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative organisms
Oral tablet can be taken with or without food
content.longDescription: Azithromycin 250mg blocks bacterial protein synthesis and is a go-to option for mild to moderate respiratory, ENT and skin infections, and selected STIs. Its shorter regimens and convenient dosing make it a practical first-line choice.

content.shortDescription: Aminopenicillin antibiotic for common respiratory, ENT, skin and dental infections.
keyFeatures: Often first-line when susceptibility is likely
content.longDescription: Amoxicillin 250mg interferes with bacterial cell-wall synthesis and is widely used for pharyngitis, otitis media, sinusitis, bronchitis, skin and soft-tissue infections and dental infections when organisms are susceptible.

content.shortDescription: Aminopenicillin antibiotic for a wide range of respiratory, ENT, skin and dental infections.
keyBenefits: Flexible dosing across different ages and conditions
keyFeatures: First-line choice for many susceptible infections
content.longDescription: Amoxicillin 500mg works by inhibiting bacterial cell-wall synthesis and is widely used for treating pharyngitis, otitis media, sinusitis, bronchitis, skin and soft tissue infections, and dental infections when organisms are susceptible. It offers higher potency and convenient dosing for adults and pediatric patients.

content.shortDescription: Versatile tetracycline-class antibiotic for respiratory, urinary, STI, skin and travel-related infections.
keyBenefits: Broad-spectrum coverage across many bacterial pathogens
Anti-inflammatory benefits for acne and rosacea
Used for malaria prophylaxis in endemic regions
content.longDescription: Doxycycline 100mg inhibits bacterial protein synthesis and is used for bronchitis, atypical pneumonia, UTIs, chlamydial infections, acne, rosacea and malaria prevention. It is affordable, dependable and easy to take under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Combination of amoxicillin with clavulanic acid to overcome beta-lactamase resistance in tough infections.
keyBenefits: Rapid symptom relief in respiratory, urinary, skin and dental infections
keyFeatures: Typically dosed twice daily with meals
content.longDescription: Augmentin 1g pairs amoxicillin with a beta-lactamase inhibitor to restore activity against resistant strains. Indicated for sinusitis, bronchitis, UTIs, skin and soft-tissue and odontogenic infections, it delivers reliable outcomes when used as directed.

content.shortDescription: Dual-action amoxicillin 500mg plus clavulanate 125mg for broader, resistance-breaking coverage.
keyBenefits: Enhanced bacterial elimination in difficult infections
Lowers risk of treatment failure due to beta-lactamase
Covers respiratory, urinary, skin and dental infections
content.longDescription: Amoxyclav 625mg extends amoxicillin’s spectrum with clavulanate, improving outcomes in infections where resistance is a concern. Commonly prescribed for recurrent chest infections, sinusitis, UTIs, cellulitis and dental abscesses.

content.shortDescription: Deworming tablet for pinworm, roundworm, hookworm and whipworm; improves gut comfort and nutrient uptake.
keyBenefits: Broad-spectrum activity across common intestinal helminths
Supports digestive health by clearing infestations
Helps prevent recurrence and spread with proper use
keyFeatures: Simple oral dosing suitable for children and adults
content.longDescription: Mebendazole 100mg inhibits parasite glucose uptake, leading to death and expulsion of worms. It is widely used in routine deworming and for symptomatic infections under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Single-dose, high-strength deworming option for rapid elimination of intestinal parasites.
keyBenefits: Effective removal of roundworms, pinworms and hookworms
Restores digestive comfort and nutritional status
Suitable for all ages when supervised
keyFeatures: Convenient single-tablet regimen for many infections
Meets global standards for safety and efficacy
content.longDescription: Mebendazole 500mg delivers a one-shot approach to deworming in appropriate indications, simplifying treatment for families and community programs while maintaining proven effectiveness.

content.shortDescription: Broad-spectrum antiparasitic traditionally used in veterinary care; increasingly researched for human applications.
keyBenefits: Targets roundworms, hookworms, whipworms and some tapeworms
Supports gut comfort by reducing parasite load
Subject of ongoing research for broader wellness roles
keyFeatures: Veterinary-trusted compound; human use requires guidance
content.longDescription: Fenbendazole 222mg disrupts parasite metabolism leading to death and expulsion. While established in animals, it is being explored for human health under supervision. Consult a professional before use.

content.shortDescription: High-potency fenbendazole formulation for broad antiparasitic coverage; discussed in emerging wellness protocols.
keyBenefits: Eliminates a range of intestinal worms
Generally well tolerated when used responsibly
keyFeatures: 444mg strong dose in powder or tablet formats
Simple oral administration, often mixed with food
content.longDescription: Fenbendazole 444mg provides potent anti-helminthic activity with a favorable safety profile from veterinary experience. Any personal use should be medically supervised.

content.shortDescription: Single-dose antiparasitic tablet that kills roundworm, hookworm, whipworm and tapeworm by blocking glucose uptake.
keyBenefits: Rapid parasite elimination and improved gut health
Suitable for mass deworming under supervision
keyFeatures: Easy single-dose administration for many cases
content.longDescription: Albendazole 400mg is widely deployed in clinical and public-health settings to treat intestinal helminth infections. By starving parasites of energy, it clears infestations and supports overall wellbeing.

content.shortDescription: Topical ivermectin for rosacea and mite-related skin issues; reduces redness, bumps and inflammation.
keyBenefits: Kills Demodex and other mites at the source
content.longDescription: Ivermectin 1% Cream targets the organisms that drive certain inflammatory dermatoses while calming redness and papules. The lightweight base is easy to apply on the face and affected areas as part of a skincare plan.

content.shortDescription: Immune-modulating tablet used for rheumatoid arthritis, lupus and certain malaria indications.
keyBenefits: Reduces joint pain, swelling and fatigue
Suitable for long-term symptom control under supervision
content.longDescription: Hydroxychloroquine 200mg modulates immune signaling to curb inflammation in RA and SLE and retains antimalarial utility. Use only as prescribed with appropriate monitoring.

content.shortDescription: Higher-strength hydroxychloroquine for autoimmune symptom control and malaria prophylaxis where indicated.
keyBenefits: Eases inflammation, pain and swelling in RA and SLE
May be used for malaria prevention in select settings
Supports long-term quality of life when monitored
keyFeatures: Potent 400mg dose, typically once daily with food
Oral tablet with established global use
content.longDescription: Hydroxychloroquine 400mg offers a higher daily dose for moderate to severe autoimmune symptoms under physician guidance. Regular ophthalmologic and clinical monitoring is recommended during therapy.

content.shortDescription: Anastrozole tablets for estrogen suppression in hormone-sensitive breast cancer and hormone therapy.
content.longDescription: Anastrozole Tablets provide powerful estrogen suppression, making them essential in the treatment of hormone-sensitive breast cancer and estrogen-related side effects. Used under medical supervision, they offer safe, convenient hormonal control with significant benefits for postmenopausal women and individuals in hormone regulation therapy.

content.shortDescription: Tamoxifen tablets for treating and preventing hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
keyFeatures: Backed by decades of clinical use
content.longDescription: Tamoxifen Tablets are a well-established hormonal therapy used to treat and prevent estrogen-sensitive breast cancer. By blocking estrogen in breast tissue, Tamoxifen helps prevent recurrence and progression of cancer in early and advanced stages. Also prescribed for high-risk individuals, it serves as a preventive measure.

content.shortDescription: Levatinib tablets for targeted cancer therapy in thyroid, kidney, and liver cancers.
content.longDescription: Levatinib Tablets are a powerful targeted therapy used in advanced thyroid, kidney, and liver cancers. As a tyrosine kinase inhibitor, it blocks cancer-promoting pathways, reduces tumor growth, and extends progression-free survival. Oral administration provides a convenient, non-invasive treatment option under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Oseltamivir tablets for fast and effective treatment of influenza (flu) symptoms.
keyBenefits: Prevents flu transmission in close contact settings
content.longDescription: Oseltamivir Tablets offer a reliable antiviral treatment for influenza A and B. It helps shorten illness duration, reduce symptoms, and protect against complications such as pneumonia and sinus infections. Suitable for adults and children over one year, it is most effective when started early and used under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Tapentadol 100mg tablets for fast and effective relief of moderate to severe pain.
keyBenefits: Rapid pain relief for acute or chronic conditions
Effective for post-surgical, musculoskeletal, or nerve pain
Less gastrointestinal upset compared to traditional opioids
keyFeatures: Dual mechanism of action (opioid + norepinephrine reuptake inhibition)
content.longDescription: Tapentadol 100mg Tablets provide powerful relief for moderate to severe pain. Combining opioid receptor agonism with norepinephrine reuptake inhibition, it works quickly and lasts longer than conventional painkillers. Ideal for post-operative, musculoskeletal, or neuropathic pain, it offers advanced pain management with fewer side effects.

content.shortDescription: Carisoprodol 350mg tablets for fast-acting relief from muscle pain and spasms.
keyBenefits: Rapid relief from muscle pain and tension
content.longDescription: Carisoprodol 350mg Tablets are a prescription muscle relaxant that alleviates acute musculoskeletal pain and stiffness. Acting on the central nervous system, it relaxes tense muscles, eases discomfort from injuries or strain, and supports short-term recovery under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Pregabalin 300mg tablets for neuropathic pain, anxiety, and seizure control.
content.longDescription: Pregabalin 300mg Tablets provide advanced relief for nerve pain, anxiety disorders, and epilepsy-related seizures. Acting on overactive nerves in the brain and spinal cord, it improves mobility, reduces discomfort, and enhances quality of life under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Pregabalin 450mg tablets for high-strength relief from neuropathic pain, anxiety, and seizures.
content.longDescription: Pregabalin 450mg Tablets deliver targeted, high-strength relief for nerve pain, anxiety disorders, and certain seizures. Designed for individuals who need stronger support than lower doses, it modulates nerve activity and provides consistent symptom control under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Gabapentin 400mg tablets for effective nerve pain and seizure relief.
content.longDescription: Gabapentin 400mg Tablets are a versatile, non-opioid medication that alleviates nerve-related pain and helps control certain seizures. It improves comfort, mobility, and sleep quality for individuals with chronic neuropathic conditions under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Gabapentin 600mg tablets for enhanced relief from neuropathic pain and seizure disorders.
content.longDescription: Gabapentin 600mg Tablets provide high-strength support for managing nerve pain and certain seizure disorders. It is effective for patients requiring stronger neuropathic relief while maintaining safety and tolerability under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Gabapentin 800mg tablets for maximum neuropathic pain and seizure relief.
content.longDescription: Gabapentin 800mg Tablets offer maximum relief for nerve pain, anxiety, and certain seizures. Designed for patients requiring the highest therapeutic effect, it provides consistent symptom control and improved quality of life under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: T3 Tablets offer fast-acting thyroid hormone support for low T3 levels and metabolic boost.
content.longDescription: T3 Tablets provide advanced support for individuals with low T3 levels or hypothyroidism. Each tablet contains synthetic Liothyronine Sodium, a fast-acting thyroid hormone that enhances metabolism, restores energy, and improves cognitive function. Recommended for metabolic support, thyroid regulation, and energy enhancement under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: T4 Tablets provide essential thyroid hormone replacement for hypothyroidism and metabolic support.
content.longDescription: T4 Tablets contain Levothyroxine Sodium, a synthetic form of thyroxine (T4) essential for regulating metabolism, energy, and overall hormonal balance. Prescribed for hypothyroidism, T4 helps restore hormone levels, relieve fatigue, improve focus, and maintain overall well-being with consistent daily use under medical guidance.

content.shortDescription: T3 + T4 Tablets provide dual thyroid hormone support for optimal metabolic and hormonal balance.
content.longDescription: T3 + T4 Tablets combine Triiodothyronine (T3) and Thyroxine (T4) for comprehensive thyroid hormone support. Designed for individuals with hypothyroidism or low energy, these tablets help restore metabolism, enhance energy, improve cognitive function, and assist with weight management. Clinically supported and recommended for use under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Low Dose Naltrexone 1.5mg Tablets support immune modulation and chronic pain relief.
keyBenefits: Supports chronic pain and fatigue relief
content.longDescription: Low Dose Naltrexone (LDN) 1.5mg Tablets offer gentle support for immune function, inflammation, and neurological health. By modulating endorphin levels and immune activity, LDN can improve chronic pain, fatigue, and mood in conditions like fibromyalgia, MS, and autoimmune disorders. Suitable for long-term wellness plans under medical supervision.

content.shortDescription: Low Dose Naltrexone 3mg Tablets provide immune support and help manage chronic inflammation.
content.longDescription: Low Dose Naltrexone 3mg Tablets are designed to gently modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and support neurological health. Used off-label for conditions like fibromyalgia, autoimmune disorders, and chronic pain, LDN 3mg promotes overall wellness and emotional balance without addictive risks.

content.shortDescription: Low Dose Naltrexone 4.5mg Tablets for immune support, inflammation control, and chronic pain relief.
keyBenefits: Improved quality of life with reduced pain and fatigue
keyFeatures: Safe for long-term use under supervision
content.longDescription: Low Dose Naltrexone 4.5mg Tablets help balance immune function, reduce chronic inflammation, and improve overall quality of life in conditions such as autoimmune disorders, fibromyalgia, and chronic fatigue syndrome. This non-addictive, physician-guided therapy enhances endorphin release and supports holistic wellness.

content.shortDescription: Naltrexone 50mg Tablets help reduce alcohol and opioid cravings and support recovery programs.
keyBenefits: Reduces cravings for alcohol and opioids
content.longDescription: Naltrexone 50mg Tablets are an FDA-approved medication used in addiction treatment to decrease alcohol and opioid cravings. By blocking opioid receptors, it reduces the rewarding effects of substance use, aiding recovery and supporting long-term abstinence in supervised treatment programs.

content.shortDescription: Varenicline 0.5mg Tablets assist in smoking cessation by reducing nicotine cravings and withdrawal symptoms.
content.longDescription: Varenicline 0.5mg Tablets are used to support smoking cessation by reducing nicotine cravings and alleviating withdrawal symptoms. Acting as a partial agonist at nicotinic receptors, Varenicline eases the transition to quitting smoking while helping maintain motivation and long-term success in cessation programs.

content.shortDescription: Varenicline 1mg Tablets provide advanced support for quitting smoking by reducing cravings and withdrawal effects.
keyBenefits: Improves success rates for quitting smoking
content.longDescription: Varenicline 1mg Tablets are prescribed to help individuals quit smoking by reducing cravings and withdrawal symptoms associated with nicotine dependence. The higher dose provides more robust support for cessation efforts, improving adherence to quitting programs and promoting long-term abstinence under physician guidance.
